title: A Compass for the Letter
author: Sable Nystrom
blurb: Tamsin Okafor, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
